Summary: REQ-D1 · Record a confirmation result per integration per deprovisioning event
Description:
For every deprovisioning event, the platform records for each connected integration whether that integration confirmed removal, and the time the result arrived.

Source: PR ¶3 / IFAQ-14

Provenance: [OBSERVED] × 2

Out of scope: showing any of this to an admin (REQ-DP1); integrations that expose no membership read (REQ-D3)

Depends on: —
Acceptance Criteria:
GIVEN a workspace with a connected integration that supports a membership read
WHEN  an admin removes a user
THEN  a confirmation result is recorded for that integration with an outcome and a timestamp
AND   the result is recorded whether the outcome is confirmed, still-present, or no-response
Parent: R1 Confirmation recorded for the highest-volume integration

Summary: REQ-DP1 · Show confirmation state on the audit entry
Description:
The audit entry for a removal shows each connected integration with its confirmation outcome and timestamp.

Source: PR ¶3 / EFAQ-05

Provenance: [OBSERVED] × 1

Out of scope: remediating from the entry (see Flagged, REQ-DP9); email or webhook notification

Depends on: REQ-D1
Acceptance Criteria:
GIVEN a deprovisioning event with one integration confirmed and one not responding
WHEN  an admin opens the audit entry for that removal
THEN  the entry shows an incomplete state and names the integration that did not respond
AND   a confirmation arriving after the entry was first rendered updates the state on next view

Summary: REQ-DP3 · Never render an unrun check as complete
Description:
Where the confirmation mechanism did not run, the audit entry says so and does not display a complete state.

Source: 03-demo-spec.md F5 / PR ¶2

Provenance: [OBSERVED] × 1

Out of scope: alerting engineering when the mechanism fails

Depends on: REQ-DP1
Acceptance Criteria:
GIVEN the confirmation mechanism did not execute for a deprovisioning event
WHEN  an admin opens the audit entry for that removal
THEN  the entry states that the check did not run
AND   no code path renders complete in the absence of a recorded confirmation result

Summary: R3 · All connected integrations, with honest coverage
Description:
Ships: confirmation across every connected integration; unreachable distinguished from failed; integrations that cannot be checked stated as such at connection and counted in the denominator; revocation state in the access-review export; a real propagation-rate baseline.

Requirements: REQ-D2, REQ-D3, REQ-D4, REQ-DP2, REQ-DP4

Depends on: R2

Blocked by: BLK-05

Test harness:
- Per integration type: confirm, still-present, and unreachable each produce the correct distinct outcome
- An integration with no membership read produces unverifiable-not-supported and appears in the rate denominator
- Export carries all four states and names responsible integrations
- Connection-time coverage statement appears once, not per removal
- Rate computation over a seeded period matches a hand-computed figure
Epic Name: R3 All connected integrations, with honest coverage

Summary: REQ-D2 · Distinguish an unreachable integration from a failed propagation
Description:
A confirmation result records unreachable and still-present as different outcomes, and the platform never reports the first as the second.

Source: 03-demo-spec.md F3 / IFAQ-11

Provenance: [OBSERVED] × 1

Out of scope: retry policy and backoff; alerting on provider outages

Depends on: REQ-D1
Acceptance Criteria:
GIVEN a connected integration that is returning transport errors
WHEN  an admin removes a user and the integration cannot be reached inside the window
THEN  the result is recorded as unverifiable-provider-unavailable, not as incomplete
AND   a subsequent successful check on the same event overwrites it with the real outcome
Parent: R3 All connected integrations, with honest coverage

Summary: REQ-D3 · Enumerate which connected integrations can be checked at all
Description:
The platform holds, per integration type, whether a membership read is available, and treats absence of that capability as a stated limitation rather than a passing check.

Source: IFAQ-12 / EFAQ-03

Provenance: [OBSERVED] × 1, [UNKNOWN] × 1

Out of scope: building membership reads for integrations that lack them; renegotiating integration contracts

Depends on: BLK-05
Acceptance Criteria:
GIVEN an integration type with no membership read available
WHEN  a deprovisioning event occurs on a workspace using it
THEN  the result is recorded as unverifiable-not-supported
AND   that integration is excluded from the numerator and included in the denominator of the propagation rate
Parent: R3 All connected integrations, with honest coverage

Description:
Once confirmation results exist, the platform reports Revocation Propagation Rate over a period, with unverifiable events counted in the denominator.

Source: PR ¶3 / IFAQ-15 / 05-telemetry.md

Provenance: [OBSERVED] × 1, [UNKNOWN] × 1

Out of scope: setting a target (Q-15, unanswered); any retroactive baseline (REQ-D6)

Acceptance Criteria:
GIVEN confirmation results have been recorded for a full reporting period
WHEN  the propagation rate is computed for that period

AND   the report states the period and the number of events it covers
Parent: R3 All connected integrations, with honest coverage

Summary: REQ-DP2 · Carry revocation state into the access-review export
Description:
Each removal in the access-review export carries its confirmation state and the names of any integrations that did not confirm.

GIVEN a date range containing removals in each of the four states
